note: Hand-written tables (Hebrew typed here and in alphabet.json only). Each cell: form, code (the STEP morphology code it should have), parse (the data's own description of that code, from orig/morph-heb.json), cellLabel, and scope: "morpheme" compares one part of a word (the article הַ; a verb form without a prefix), "word" the whole word with its prefixes and suffixes. key (on the table, or on a cell) = the course key of the word, or the H9xxx number of a prefix or suffix. Checked against orig/ot by scripts/build-hebrew-course.js; results in paradigm-check.json.
